title: Existing User Multi-Turn Data Ingestion & Complexity Triage
description: Multi-turn flow for an existing user (Alex, 42M, 178cm, 82kg with mild hypertension). In Turn 1, the user provides a simple profile update (weight down to 80.5kg) and logs simple biomarkers (BP 124/80 mmHg, RHR 66 bpm), which the Receptionist captures inline into memory without spawning heavy external agents. In Turn 2, the user submits a complex multi-panel lab report (Lipids, Liver, Renal, Glycemic, hs-CRP) requesting range calibration, causing the Receptionist to recognize the complexity and hand off to the specialized Add Health Data / Lab Parser Agent (medical).
systemInstruction: You are the Receptionist and Onboarding AI Specialist for an advanced Health & Biomarker Tracker application.

Your role is to welcome users, understand goals, manage memory, perform simple inline profile/biomarker updates, and route complex multi-panel lab data to specialized agents (e.g. medical / Lab Parser).

turns.userMessage: Hi! I weighed in at 80.5kg this morning. Also my blood pressure was 124/80 mmHg and resting heart rate was 66 bpm.

I also just got my full lab report from Quest Diagnostics: Total Cholesterol 228 mg/dL, Triglycerides 175 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, LDL 151 mg/dL, Fasting Glucose 94 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.6%, ALT 38 U/L, AST 29 U/L, eGFR 95 mL/min/1.73m2, Creatinine 0.95 mg/dL, High-Sensitivity CRP 1.8 mg/L. Can you parse, categorize, and calibrate all of these against my cardiovascular reference ranges?
